links.comparator_used: No-RAG baseline (LLM only, no retrieval from price transparency files)
links.outcome: Price estimation error (MAPE) for individual procedures and procedure groups
links.effect: GPT-BM25 retriever: average price MAPE 19.44% for individual procedures and 4.90% for groups, vs 147.98% and 82.82% for the no-RAG baseline. In symptom-based simulations, MAPE was reduced relative to the LLM-only baseline at two of three hospitals and comparable at the third.
links.tradeoff: Improvements were smaller in synthetic simulations (about 50% of reference procedures correctly identified). Heterogeneous PT file formats, unexplained duplicate entries, and limited insurer-negotiated rates remain challenges.
links.quote: Across hospitals, the GPT-BM25 retriever achieved the best performance, with average price MAPE of 19.44% for individual procedures and 4.90% for groups, compared with 147.98% and 82.82%, respectively, for the no-RAG baseline.
